*This post was originally a [Twitter thread](https://x.com/mathzorro/status/1248656214478766081). It started when Annie Perkins shared [#MathArtChallenge Day 26: Golden Spiral](https://arbitrarilyclosecom.wordpress.com/2020/04/10/mathartchallenge-day-26-golden-spiral/). I replied that it could be turned into wearable art, and she pointed out that golden spiral jewelry is decidedly available. The Apollonian jewelry followed in [Designing Apollonian Earrings](../2020-05-01-designing-apollonian-earrings/index.qmd) and [An Apollonian Necklace](../2020-05-02-an-apollonian-necklace/index.qmd).*

[\@anniek_p](https://x.com/anniek_p) I try to create more interesting jewelry.  Like these discrete dynamical systems.
<https://hanusadesign.com/products/cobweb-earrings-metal>

I have been developing some Apollonian jewelry.  I'd been wanting to do so for a long time and the code shared by one of the #mathartchallenge responses allowed me to develop it.  I'll share it soon.
